name: Tortoise's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Every King move has a 1/2 chance to also count as waiting.
description: A rare King gambit. Each time you move your King there is a 1/2 chance the move also fires the game's 'wait' event, so anything that triggers on waiting triggers too. With Anarchist active, every piece counts as a King for this roll. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
